recreation_prompt_markdown:
# Recreation Prompt

Recreate a single-page mobile-first browser clicker called **Snoozy Spell Jar Clicker**. Preserve the mechanics of a central tap target that awards currency, a charge meter that rises by valid taps and decays over time, a temporary 5x surge state at full charge, critical hits from an upgrade, idle income from an upgrade, and five purchasable upgrades with escalating costs. Reframe the game as a cozy satirical witch tap/idle game: the player taps a pastel spell jar for moon crumbs, buys charms in a Charm Closet, and triggers a Full-Moon Freakout. Use procedural Canvas/CSS art for a bow-topped spell jar, drifting sparkles, petals, clouds, cottage silhouettes, and readable one-thumb portrait UI. Keep all code self-contained in `index.html` where feasible and use only approved catalog fonts/audio/GIF URLs for media.
blueprint_markdown:
# Blueprint

## Source Truth
The preserved source is a mobile portrait canvas clicker. The player starts the run, taps a central canvas core within a circular hit radius, earns an energy currency, fills a charge meter by 5 per valid tap, triggers a temporary 5x surge when charge reaches 100, and buys five upgrades: tap power, idle income, charge stability, critical chance, and surge duration.

## Protected Mechanics
- Start button reveals HUD and bottom shop control.
- Primary input is pointer/click/touch on the central canvas object only.
- Tap gain formula remains `floor(clickPower * multiplier)` with charge multiplier from 1x to 3x, surge multiplier 5x, and critical 10x multiplier.
- Charge increments by 5 per non-surge tap, decays over time with stability reducing decay, and converts to a timed surge at 100.
- Passive income ticks once per second when the auto upgrade level is above zero.
- Upgrade costs and formulas are preserved exactly from the source.
- There is no finite win/loss state; progression is endless incremental earning.

## Remix Target
Regenerate the public game as **Snoozy Spell Jar Clicker**, a cozy satirical witchy tap/idle game with pastel dream, barbiecore, cottagecore, and bedtime-session energy. The central tapped object becomes a bow-topped spell jar that earns moon crumbs. Upgrades become charms in a Charm Closet. Surge becomes Full-Moon Freakout. Presentation is rebuilt with inline CSS/Canvas/JS and catalog-approved fonts/media.

## Safe Transformation Surfaces
HUD labels, title, start copy, upgrade names/descriptions, canvas art, background, particles, feedback text, audio mapping, GIF feedback, palette, and mobile UI styling are presentation-only and safe to transform.
